description: This file contains validation functions for strings, emails, IP addresses, filenames, URLs, and SEO URLs used in the OpenCart system. It defines helper functions to validate different input types and ensure data correctness within the project.

methods.name: oc_validate_length
methods.description: Validates that a given string's length falls within specified minimum and maximum bounds after trimming whitespace.

methods.name: oc_validate_email
methods.description: Checks if the provided email address is valid, handling internationalized domain names.

methods.name: oc_validate_ip
methods.description: Validates if the given string is a valid IP address.

methods.name: oc_validate_filename
methods.description: Ensures the filename contains only allowed characters (Latin, Cyrillic, digits, dot, dash, underscore).

methods.name: oc_validate_url
methods.description: Validates if the provided string is a properly formatted URL.

methods.name: oc_validate_seo_url
methods.description: Checks if the SEO URL keyword contains only allowed characters (Latin, Cyrillic, Greek, digits, slash, dot, dash, underscore).
